errors.evidence: This misrepresents the trend of the blue line. The line decreases from x=0.1 (y≈23.3) to x=0.2 (y≈22.5), but then slightly increases to x=0.3 (y≈22.6). Describing this as a continuous decrease to the point at 0.3 is an inaccurate oversimplification of the trend.
The value for the blue line at x=0.3 is approximately 22.6, not 22.8.
The orange line begins at x=0.1 with a y-value of approximately 29.2. The stated value of 30.5 is a significant overestimation.

errors.text_span: and then remains relatively stable until 0.5
errors.evidence: This description is misleading. The orange line shows a notable increase from x=0.2 (y≈27.4) to x=0.3 (y≈28.2) before it stabilizes between x=0.3 and x=0.5 (y≈28.1). Ignoring the increase from 0.2 to 0.3 is a significant oversimplification of the trend.
